title: Open-Meteo historical archive – London grid point, 19–27 April 2026
claims: Open-Meteo archive data for 19–27 April 2026 at the returned grid point 51.4938 N, -0.1630 W at 16 m elevation give daily maximum temperatures from 13.4 °C to 21.7 °C with a median of 18.1 °C.
The same window gives daily minimum temperatures from 4.6 °C to 7.9 °C with a median of 6.4 °C.
Total precipitation in the nine-day window is 0.6 mm, all on 27 April 2026; eight days record 0.0 mm and no day reaches 1 mm.
On 26 April 2026 the grid point records a maximum of 19.5 °C, a minimum of 7.5 °C and 0.0 mm precipitation.
The values are modelled/reanalysis grid data, not measurements at the course.
